sloka: भगवंस्तनयां मे त्वं गुणैः स्वैरेव भूषिताम् ।भिक्षां प्रतिगृहाणेमां महर्षे स्वयमुद्यताम् ।। ७.२.२५ ॥
transliteration: bhagavaṁstanayāṁ me tvaṁ guṇaiḥ svaireva bhūṣitām ।bhikṣāṁ pratigṛhāṇemāṁ maharṣe svayamudyatām ।। 7.2.25 ॥

translations.english: O revered great sage, please accept this daughter of mine, adorned with her own virtues, as an offering that she herself is ready to make.
